body: New item from audit B-51 (proven on an emulator, 6 Nov 2026): a finished list played again ends in a silent 'playing' state. The root is playback_engine.dart:1296-1297 (a second completion of the same load is ignored). Fix, acceptance and the test are in docs/tasks/P1-instant-play-and-worst-bugs.md section P1-21; the proof is docs/evidence/README.md#d01 and docs/tasks/AUDIT-BUILT-2026-11-05.md B-51.
